      "component": "Payments agent / shared message queue",

        "then": "no charge is attempted and the duplicate is recorded as rejected"

      "component": "Shared message queue",

      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication." }

      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication. The payments agent can charge the user’s saved card." }

      "impact": 3,
